additional_info.subject: RE: ID0418779-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2 / P0 312569868/02 ] Engie Vianeo- Overheating CRM:02684000104
additional_info.body:
Dear Maxime Maucler,
Hope you are doing well,
As you mentioned, and based on the picture provided, it appears that the DC connector pin has experienced overheating. There is a significant risk of further melting during future charging sessions. As a precautionary safety measure, we strongly recommend either disabling the affected outlet or shutting down the entire charger until a thorough on-site inspection and further troubleshooting can be performed.
We have escalated this incident to our regional team and are coordinating a site visit for detailed investigation.
In the meantime, to support our analysis and plan the next steps more effectively, we kindly request the following additional information:
The
total kWh delivered
by the affected outlet.
An
estimate of the total number of charging sessions
performed on this outlet.
Confirmation on whether a
Charge Management System (CMS)
is installed and active.
A
clear picture of the plug type label
for reference.
Thank you for your cooperation. We look forward to your response to help us resolve this issue promptly and ensure safety.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
